nights.title: The Scratch
nights.name: The Scratch
nights.extract: The Scratch are an Irish band based in Dublin, whose music blends Irish traditional music and heavy metal.

nights.title: Ayra Starr: Starrgirl World Tour
nights.name: Ayra Starr
nights.extract: Oyinkansola Sarah Aderibigbe, known professionally as Ayra Starr, is a Beninese-born Nigerian singer-songwriter and producer.

nights.title: almost monday
nights.name: Almost Monday
nights.extract: Almost Monday is an American indie pop band based in San Diego, California.
